problems: The grass is an endless floor, so the horizon sits at the very top of the card and the pink backdrop shows only as a thin strip. A pink backdrop is part of the brief. For category 3 use a finite grass slab under the hero, so the simple pink backdrop shows clearly behind it.
The body's lathe profile has too few points. The belly renders as visible flat bands that can carry into the restyle, so it needs a smooth, densely sampled profile.
Once the belly is smoothed the wall at handle height pulls in, so the lugs are moved inward to stay sunk into the wall. The ring handles stay hooked through the lugs and hang clear of the wall.

The legs lean outward at the top, so each leg's top sticks out past the belly. The flat top shows under the pot, most clearly on the right front leg, so the legs look stuck on rather than cast into the belly. Fix: make the legs straight and set them closer in, so their tops sit well inside the belly.
The round belly shows flat facet bands in the reflection. Fix: use a denser lathe (more vertices) so the curve is smooth.
The front edge of the grass slab shows at the bottom of the card. Fix: extend the slab toward the camera so it runs off the bottom edge.
